description: Hierarchical multi-tier rate limiter only deducts tokens from target child leaf, allowing tenants to collectively exceed parent capacity.
spec_notes: HierarchicalRateLimiter.allow_request must deduct consumed tokens across all ancestors along the tree path.

tests.test_hierarchical_rate_limiter.py:
from token_bucket import TokenBucket
from hierarchy import HierarchyNode
from limiter import HierarchicalRateLimiter


def test_hierarchical_consumption_at_all_tiers():
    # Global: cap=10, refill=1/s
    root = HierarchyNode("global", TokenBucket.create(10, 1))
    # Tenant 1: cap=5, refill=1/s
    tenant1 = HierarchyNode("t1", TokenBucket.create(5, 1))
    # Tenant 2: cap=5, refill=1/s
    tenant2 = HierarchyNode("t2", TokenBucket.create(5, 1))
    root.add_child(tenant1)
    root.add_child(tenant2)
    limiter = HierarchicalRateLimiter(root)
    t = 100.0
    # Consume 4 from tenant1 -> root should have 6 remaining
    assert limiter.allow_request(tenant1, 4, t) is True
    # Consume 4 from tenant2 -> root should have 2 remaining
    assert limiter.allow_request(tenant2, 4, t) is True
    # Tenant2 still has 1 token left, but root only has 2 tokens left. Requesting 3 on t2 must FAIL at root!
    assert limiter.allow_request(tenant2, 3, t) is False


def test_tenant_burst_does_not_exceed_global_capacity():
    root = HierarchyNode("global", TokenBucket.create(10, 0))
    t1 = HierarchyNode("t1", TokenBucket.create(10, 0))
    t2 = HierarchyNode("t2", TokenBucket.create(10, 0))
    root.add_child(t1)
    root.add_child(t2)
    limiter = HierarchicalRateLimiter(root)
    t = 100.0
    # Exhaust root via t1
    assert limiter.allow_request(t1, 10, t) is True
    # t2 has 10 initial tokens, but root has 0 -> must be blocked
    assert limiter.allow_request(t2, 1, t) is False


def test_child_failure_does_not_leak_parent_tokens():
    root = HierarchyNode("global", TokenBucket.create(10, 0))
    t1 = HierarchyNode("t1", TokenBucket.create(2, 0))
    root.add_child(t1)
    limiter = HierarchicalRateLimiter(root)
    t = 100.0
    # Request 5 tokens from t1 (t1 has only 2) -> rejected
    assert limiter.allow_request(t1, 5, t) is False
    # Root must still retain all 10 tokens!
    assert root.bucket.tokens == 10.0
